QuestInfo.name: At Ease
QuestInfo.0: Tumbleweed told you that the village is a part of another dimension from Maple World, called Grandis. You can go to Maple World through the Dimensional Gate, meaning you finally found a way to return to Maple World! But...
QuestInfo.1: You must return to Maple World, to ensure your destiny was fulfilled. However, you keep thinking about Moonbeam. Get something to prove you are a brave fox so she can be at ease.
QuestInfo.2: You showed Moonbeam your tokens of bravery, but she still doesn't seem at ease.

1.0: Why did you follow me? Did you... hear everything?

default.0: I'm not in the mood to talk to you, Shade. Leave it alone.
